description: Paragens is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto da Mobilidade e dos Transportes. Regular Passenger Transport Services stops serving the municipalities of Lisbon and Porto. Source: STePP, 2019-experimental version. Coverage: Instituto da Mobilidade e dos Transportes. The portal shows the English title as "Stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto da Mobilidade e dos Transportes. Its keywords include mobilidade, transportes-publicos. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS. The listing shows 2019-05-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
